ModMetaData.name: Terramorph Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces sarg.alphaanimals' AA_Terramorph art (all lifeStages share this one texPath; the dessicated-corpse texture stays on donor art) with custom generated art. LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/AA_Terramorph/AA_Terramorph_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
Donor ships this art as loose PNGs already (not AssetBundle-packed), so this is a plain file overwrite by load order.
